## Ethereal Marauder (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 N Medium magical beast  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +8  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural)  
 **hp** 40 (4d10)  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +5, **Will** +2  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +6 (1d6+3)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 14, **Dex** 13, **Con** 11, **Int** 7, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 18  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Perception +8, Stealth +8; **Racial Modifiers** +2 to Perception and Stealth checks  
 **SQ** ethereal jaunt  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Ethereal Jaunt (Su)** As a free action, an ethereal marauder can move from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane and shift back as a move action. This ability otherwise mimics the effects of the ethereal jaunt spell.  
 
 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** Ethereal Plane  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** standard
